result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one noticeable visual defect: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' restaurant title is clipped mid-character instead of being properly truncated, despite there appearing to be available space before the rating element.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section is clipped mid-glyph (rendered as 'Tokumaru Rameı'), cutting off the final character without an ellipsis, even though there is significant empty space between the title and the 4.8 rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title container's width constraint so it can use the available space up to the rating element, and apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g., text-overflow: ellipsis) instead of hard clipping mid-character.
